definitions.explanation: Not complex; having few parts or elements; easy to understand.
Lacking depth of thought; easily fooled or led (sometimes pejorative).

examples.japanese: {単純|たんじゅん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{単純|たんじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦すると→すると：01627_suruto⟧、⟦こういう→こういう：21476_kouiu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: To put it simply, this is what it means.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{単純|たんじゅん}⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: He's simple-minded, so he believes things easily.

examples.japanese: {単純|たんじゅん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It's a simple task, so anyone can do it.

examples.japanese: {単純|たんじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{褒|ほ}められて→褒める：01204_homeru⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んでいる→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: He's simply happy about being praised.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんなに→そんなに：01646_sonnani⟧{単純|たんじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えない→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦ほう→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: You shouldn't think about it so simplistically.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {単純|たんじゅん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun: simple (noun)
- {単純|たんじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: simply (adverb)

USAGE:
- Sense 1 is neutral/positive: uncomplicated, straightforward
- Sense 2 can be negative: naive, gullible

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {単純|たんじゅん}: Simple (structure/complexity)
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧: Easy, simple (difficulty level)
- ⟦{素朴|そぼく}→素朴：06071_soboku⟧: Simple, naive (innocent quality)
- ⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧: Complex, complicated
